articles.title: Indian bonds breathe easy as Treasury yields decline
articles.content: Early Thursday, bonds issued by the Indian government saw slight upswings, influenced by a rally in US Treasuries. Despite this, concerns over liquidity, climbing interest rates, and mounting supply challenges have capped these hikes. Traders are curbing risk levels prior to a major debt auction, while rising domestic inflation fuels anticipations of a tougher monetary approach from the Reserve Bank of India, as evidenced by the expanding India-U.S. yield spread.

articles.title: Largecaps are shrinking, smallcaps are getting bigger: What is changing in India’s stock market?
articles.content: The Indian stock market is witnessing a notable transformation as large-cap stocks are losing ground amidst changing capital flows and investor sentiment. Mid- and small-cap companies are surging ahead, capturing more market capitalization as domestic institutional investors pivot towards these segments. As large-caps endure foreign selling pressures, the contrast in performance underscores a shift in market dynamics. Future outcomes will hinge on whether earnings growth aligns with current valuations.
